component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "drain" m.inTask = false m.seen = [] end sub
' XML onChange on the task thread. The first value keeps the handler busy (no wait/sleep) for ' 500ms while the Scene keeps writing, one value per 20ms, so each arrives as a lone update. sub onReq(event as object) v = event.getData() if v <= 3 then print "ONCHANGE v=" + v.toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() if not m.inTask then return m.seen.push(v) if v = 1 ts = CreateObject("roTimespan") x = 0 while ts.TotalMilliseconds() < 500 x = x + 1 end while end if end sub
sub drain() m.inTask = true m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("request", m.port) m.top.ready = true portCount = 0 idle = 0 while idle < 20 msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" idle = 0 portCount++ else idle++ end if end while inversions = 0 missing = [] last = 0 present = {} for each v in m.seen if v < last then inversions++ last = v present[v.toStr()] = true end for for v = 1 to 30 if not present.doesExist(v.toStr()) then missing.push(v.toStr()) end for m.top.report = "onChange n=" + m.seen.count().toStr() + " inversions=" + inversions.toStr() + " missing=[" + missing.join(",") + "] | port n=" + portCount.toStr() + " | final field=" + m.top.request.toStr() end sub
